Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
FIXED CLAMP SUPPORTS 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensions and other requirements for fixed damp supports to be used 
with goose neck clamps conforming to IS : 4279-1984 'Specification for goose neck clamps 
( second revision )', swing clamps conforming to IS : 5250-1984 'Specification for swing clamp 
( first revision )', wide clamp plates conforming to IS : 5252-1984 'Specification for wide clamp 
plates ( first revision )', parallel sided clamp plates conforming to IS : 5998-1984 'Specification 
for parallel sided clamp plates ( first revision )', and slotted clamps conforming to IS : 6082-1985 
'Specification for slotted clamps ( first revision )'. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 . 

3 Material and Hardness — The material shall be suitable steel having tensiie strength 600 to 
750 N/mm 2 and hardened to 45 to 50 HRC. 

4. Designation — A fixed clamp support having c(= 12 mm and / 2 = 32 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Fixed Clamp Support 12 x 32 IS : 12250 

5. Workmanship — A fixed clamp support shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other 
defects. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to fixed clamp supports. 

6.2 These shall be packed in accordance with the best trade practice. 

7. Marking — The fixed clamp support shall be marked at an appropriate place with designation 
and manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

7.1 Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



Adopted 28 December 1987

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been formulated to reduce the variety and rationalise the sizes of fixed heel 
clamp supports used in the industry. 

In preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from BS : 5078-1 974 'Fixed heel 
clamps, steel\ issued by the British Standards Institution ( BSI ). 



Printed at Printograph, New Delhi, India
